description: Two units sharing a module, a table and a topic. The api unit reaches an async SQLAlchemy engine and an async Redis; the worker reaches a second database through the synchronous engine -- one application whose two Lambdas hold different client libraries for the same capability.

load._scale_why: One PUT publishes one message, and the emulator starts a Lambda container per delivery without reaping it -- a few hundred exhausts it regardless of how much memory the VM has. This is the emulator's ceiling, not the application's.
